body:
> How would you recommend creating a widget that just handles the count? I was thinking of using the result event to trigger AlgoliaSearchHelper.searchOnce for the other indices.

Yes that was the point of my

> 1. create a custom widget that you add to every instance of instantsearch and that will update the counts next to each tab

which was not enough detailed but you could create this widget and use the render() method to get an event when the search was really updated for the underlying instantsearch instance.

Then call otherInstances.helper.searchOnce(callback) and extract in the callback the number of hits for the hidden widgets.

Is that more clear?
